text: Write that she has a job in her country and needs to go back to it by said date, that she's not planning on staying as she has responsibilities back home. The first time I came they asked me to show them my return flight ticket. I was overly prepared the second time I came with having proof of employment/ housing from my home country.  We didn't mention in the letter that we were thinking about the partner visa, only that I was coming to visit and be a tourist in Israel
